summary: 30 publish, 12 publish_flagged, 0 reject. All 24 cited URLs were re-fetched and all 115 evidence quotations were found after allowed normalization; archived copies were required for Quantum Motion and SEC filings. Systemic issues: datelines used as headquarters evidence, cross-system/cross-document technology attribution, a stale D-Wave exchange field, inferred dates, and company claims needing separation from journal conclusions. Science DOI 10.1126/science.ado6285 is treated as preprint-derived because journal full text refused access. Intel’s 2024 target is open, not missed, because no document supports missed status.
